title: Large coefficient from irregularity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$. If the function on the sign cube obtained by transporting $f$ through the coordinatewise sign encoding is not Fourier regular at level $\varepsilon$, then there is a nonzero $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$ such that $\varepsilon<|\widehat f(\gamma)|$, where $\widehat f(\gamma)$ is the vector Fourier coefficient of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: The sign-cube transport of $f$ is not Fourier regular at level $\varepsilon$
